title: EU sets out a new Strategy for the Arctic
summary: European Commission Press release Strasbourg, 20 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy presented a new Strategy for the Arctic. The Strategy presents a new framework of political cooperation for like-minded partners that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core. title: Commission presents its Vision 2040 for a thriving fisheries and aquaculture sector
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 20 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission presented its Vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040, setting the direction for the next 15 years to strengthen the environmental and economic viability of the sector.
